plugin:http|*: Readest's HTTP client (tauriFetch, plugin-http): OPDS catalogs, KOSync, WebDAV/Google Drive/OneDrive/S3 sync, translators, AI, Audiobookshelf, BookOrbit, Grimmory, Notion, Readwise, RSS and more. Not registered in Lite, whose runtime answers fetch() itself.
plugin:websocket|*: Edge TTS voices for Read Aloud (libs/edgeTTS.ts).
plugin:native-tts|*: Read Aloud with the system's voices (speech-dispatcher on Linux).
plugin:oauth|*: Sign-in through a local OAuth redirect (app/auth/page.tsx).
plugin:opener|open_url: Opens links in the system browser (Link.tsx, the sign-in and OPDS pages, payments).
plugin:clipboard-manager|*: Copy and paste through the system clipboard (utils/clipboard.ts).
plugin:device-info|get_battery_info: The battery level in the reader (useCurrentBattery.ts).
plugin:deep-link|get_current: Links the app was launched with. Fails at every launch on the Kindle (not allowed by ACL).
plugin:process|*: Exit and restart: data migration (MigrateDataWindow.tsx), the updater, utils/window.ts.
plugin:dialog|message: Message boxes. Lite's own dialog plugin (src-tauri/src/picker.rs) answers open only.
plugin:dialog|save: Save as. Lite's own dialog plugin (src-tauri/src/picker.rs) answers open only.
plugin:native-bridge|is_sync_keychain_av: Whether the sync passphrase can live in the system keychain. Fails at launch on the Kindle (not allowed by ACL); Readest falls back to keeping it in memory.
plugin:native-bridge|get_sync_passphrase: The sync passphrase in the system keychain.
plugin:native-bridge|set_sync_passphrase: The sync passphrase in the system keychain.
plugin:native-bridge|clear_sync_passphra: The sync passphrase in the system keychain.
plugin:native-bridge|get_sys_fonts_list: The system's fonts, for the font settings.
plugin:native-bridge|is_eink_refresh_sup: Whether the screen offers an e-ink refresh (utils/bridge.ts).
plugin:native-bridge|read_share_clip_htm: Pages shared into the app for clipping (useClipUrlIngress.ts).
plugin:native-bridge|on_device_llm_statu: Apple Intelligence's on-device model for the custom translator, offered on iOS only (isOnDeviceLLMSupported): never called elsewhere.
plugin:native-bridge|on_device_llm_cance: Apple Intelligence's on-device model for the custom translator, offered on iOS only (isOnDeviceLLMSupported): never called elsewhere.
upload_file: Uploads books and covers to Readest Cloud (utils/transfer.ts): books added in Lite don't reach the cloud.
optimize_cover_thumbnails: Shrinks downloaded covers to thumbnails (nativeAppService.ts). Fails on every cover batch on the Kindle; the covers stay full size.
read_dir: Lists a folder's books for import (nativeAppService.ts).
allow_paths_in_scopes: Opens the file-system scope to imported paths (nativeAppService.ts).
reveal_item_in_dir: Show in folder, from a book's menu (BookshelfItem.tsx).
parse_epub_metadata: Readest's Rust EPUB parser for metadata.
parse_mobi_metadata: Readest's Rust MOBI parser for metadata.
render_pdf_cover: A PDF's cover rendered in Rust (tauriPdfBridge.ts).
localsend_*: LocalSend transfers (services/localsend/service.ts). localsend_start fails on the Kindle.
extract_web_browser_archive: Books from archives the in-app browser downloads (services/webBrowser/webBrowser.ts).
clip_url: Clipping a web page into a book (app/send/page.tsx).
spawn_fresh_browser: OAuth for the sync providers in a fresh browser (services/sync/providers/oauth/oauthDesktop.ts).
plugin:updater|*: Readest's updater (helpers/updater.ts, UpdaterWindow.tsx). Lite reports the updater disabled.
plugin:cli|cli_matches: The files Readest was started with (helpers/openWith.ts). Lite hands them to the page itself (src-tauri/src/main.rs).
install_nightly_update: Readest's updater (utils/bridge.ts). Lite reports the updater disabled.
verify_update_signature: Readest's updater (utils/bridge.ts). Lite reports the updater disabled.
get_environment_variable: The USE_CUSTOM_OAUTH check on the sign-in page (app/auth/page.tsx).
get_webview_version: About Readest's WebView version (AboutWindow.tsx). Fails on the Kindle.
